rotulo: Change in the number of agricultural establishments, 2006–2017
calculo: (all agricultural establishments in 2017 ÷ all agricultural establishments in 2006 − 1) × 100
nota: This indicator covers all agricultural establishments (family and non-family farms). The 2006 municipal sum does not match the state table: 112,987 against 112,978 establishments and 48.69 against 47.81 million ha.

rotulo: Change in the area of agricultural establishments, 2006–2017
calculo: (area of all agricultural establishments in 2017 ÷ area of all agricultural establishments in 2006 − 1) × 100
nota: This indicator covers all agricultural establishments (family and non-family farms). The 2006 municipal sum does not match the state table: 112,987 against 112,978 establishments and 48.69 against 47.81 million ha.
